parsed.post: Discarding the last run (val_bpb 1.111612). The reduction in learning rate and addition of warmup seems to have overshot or destabilized. Reverting to my best (commit 4952c54, val_bpb 1.044497). Next, I'll experiment with WEIGHT_DECAY to see if it helps generalization without hurting the 5-minute convergence.
parsed.description: Testing a small weight decay to see if regularization improves the validation bits per byte within the fixed budget.
